descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-12 AI Check; UAT 3.2; TFA-92590 AC 4 · “Confirm it's stored exactly as typed, not cleaned up, reworded, or formatted into a header.”.

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S10 AI Check, Hospital (5 of 10): a shorthand point is stored exactly as typed after Save Note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 AI Check (UAT TC-12): a point typed with informal phrasing or shorthand is stored exactly as typed, not cleaned up, reworded, or formatted into a header. … (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. … (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; … (TFA-92590 AC 4; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five fresh Hospital patients, one per shorthand class: abbreviations and symbols, names and times, arrows, questions and parentheses, capitals and no punctuation

When Add the point with Add Point / Save Point, then type the matching pre-round note (same topic in clean clinical words) and Save Note with the live model; reopen

Then Per variant: the stored point is byte-for-byte the typed text and it is the only point (nothing added, edited or removed); no header, prefix, reordering, expansion of abbreviations or spelling fix

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per variant, its backendCheck (exact, case-sensitive; oracleRules 1-2). Any single mismatch (text, case, count, an extra point) fails T5 and U3 (and U1 for an added point) on its own and is quoted typed vs stored; no threshold applies to them. The 9/10 tally (3.2) over the 10 concrete results of S10 + S11 is used only for the UAT AI Check line (U6), every failure quoted. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
